title: Hangar 18
wikitext:
The clan was founded in March 1997, when the clans Marduk and Nemesiz, who had both been active during 1996 and in the first season of [[Swedish Quake League]], merged to form Hangar 18. 

Lost many of their best players when a group disjoined and started the clan [[A]] because they thought there were too many players in Hangar 18.
